### Victoria Parizot - Norwalk, CT
Victoria Parizot is a senior at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu), majoring in engineering. She is most interested with mechanical and electrical design, and excited to be taking "Microprocessor Systems: Design & Application" (AKA MicroPs) this semester!

At Harvey Mudd, she is a West Dorm President, a Machine Shop Proctor, and a Member of Tau Beta Pi Honors Society. In her free time, she enjoys woodworking, taking and developing film photos, and sailing. 

### Project PariVo
For her final project, Victoria worked with Audrey Vo to create a functional DJ mixer that manipulates audio files based on user inputs. Their mixer was able to control the frequency and gain of audio files passed in via an AUX cord based on physical inputs from the user. Learn more about the project on their project website, [here](https://projectparivo.github.io/ProjectParivoPortfolio/).
